programme2050.title: Cameroon 2050 Program
programme2050.subtitle: A social, educational, sports, and energy development program in Cameroon, over 25 years.
programme2050.intro_body: The association's mission is to contribute sustainably to the human, social, and economic development of Cameroonian communities, through charitable, educational, sports, energy, and community actions. It works to improve living conditions for vulnerable populations, particularly orphaned children, disadvantaged youth, and rural communities, by setting up structuring programs capable of having a lasting impact across generations.
programme2050.vision_body: To build in Cameroon a sports and academic center of excellence dedicated to basketball and education, able to welcome young talents from every region of the country.
vision_items: A covered basketball court meeting European standards
An academic program letting young athletes continue their studies while developing their sporting potential
Spaces dedicated to training, mentoring, and personal development
programme2050.axe_caritatif_body: Regular programs with orphanages and social structures: school supplies, occasional food support, educational support, collection and distribution of clothing and essential items, social and educational activities.
programme2050.axe_eau_body: Drilling wells across various regions of Cameroon: identifying priority areas, installing community wells, local management for maintenance, raising awareness about sustainable water use.
programme2050.axe_energie_body: Solar panel fields for public lighting in rural areas, improved safety, local economic development, and better study conditions for students thanks to improved access to electricity.
programme2050.axe_basketball_body: Camps and tournaments, scouting young talent, sports and educational training, gradual creation of facilities. Basketball camps will be organized every two years across different regions of Cameroon.
programme2050.timeline_1_body: Official founding of the association, management teams, first partnerships, first fundraising campaigns, first school-supplies distribution, first action with orphanages.
programme2050.timeline_2_title: Years 2 to 5 — Rolling out first actions
programme2050.timeline_2_body: More orphanages supported, first wells drilled, first community solar systems installed, regular basketball camps, a network of local partners.
programme2050.timeline_3_body: Actions extended to several regions, water and energy projects multiplied, first young sporting talents identified, solid financial fund built for the future center.
programme2050.timeline_4_body: Technical and architectural studies finalized, funding secured, site identified, first construction phases begun.
programme2050.timeline_5_body: Sports facilities, dormitories, and classrooms built, center administration in place, coaches and teachers recruited.
programme2050.timeline_6_title: Years 21 to 25 — Full operation and national reach
programme2050.timeline_6_body: First boarding students welcomed, a recognized sports academy, participation in national and international competitions, a new generation of Cameroonian athletes and leaders trained.
programme2050.financement_note: This section describes the association's internal strategy as defined by the organization; it is not financial or investment advice.
programme2050.financement_dons_body: Individuals, partner companies, patrons, international organizations, fundraising campaigns.
programme2050.financement_tontine_body: An organizational savings pool will be created by January 2027 at the latest. Funds centralized in Cameroon, operational management by a commissioner, disbursements requiring two to three authorized signatures, financial oversight and internal rules to guarantee transparency.
programme2050.financement_invest_body: Part of the donations received may be allocated to a responsible financial investment strategy (potentially including ETFs), to gradually build capital for financing the future center, with prudent risk management and in compliance with applicable legal obligations.
gouvernance_items: A board of directors oversees strategic direction
Major financial decisions require multiple approvals
Partners and donors are kept informed of how resources are used
impact_items: Improve living conditions for vulnerable populations
Give young sporting talents an opportunity
Create a recognized center of excellence in Cameroon
Contribute lastingly to the country's social and economic development
programme2050.conclusion_body: This project represents a long-term vision of human development based on solidarity, education, sport, and energy innovation. Through collective mobilization, transparent management, and a sustainable financial strategy, the goal is to build a lasting legacy for future generations in Cameroon.
